name: Fisetin

lead: Fisetin is a flavonol found in strawberries, apples and onions, sold as a supplement and discussed as a candidate senolytic, a compound that selectively clears senescent cells.
It gained attention after mouse studies reported extended health and lifespan. Human data are limited to early or ongoing trials, and no appearance benefit has been demonstrated.

paras: In cell and mouse studies fisetin reduced senescent-cell burden and inflammatory signaling, possibly via pathways involving PI3K/AKT and mTOR modulation, along with antioxidant effects.
Human safety data at the doses discussed online are sparse. Possible interactions with drugs are not well characterized. Legal as a supplement, but not an approved therapy for any condition.
